name: RavenQuest: Treasures Below
summary:
Treasures Below is a major expansion for the MMORPG RavenQuest, introducing new competitive ladders, deep progression systems, and challenging PvE content.

At the core of the expansion is the "Expeditions" system, a highly replayable roguelike dungeon mode where players navigate unpredictable encounters, manage debilitating Afflictions, and utilize powerful buffs called Songs to survive.

The update also heavily expands competitive play, launching Season 1 of the Ranked Arena alongside specialized, time-limited leaderboards tailored to specific playstyles like sharpshooting (Ballistics) and resource mastery (Naturalist). To support these new challenges, Treasures Below revamps character progression with advanced gear upgrade mechanics, including Warforging, Infusion, and Augmenting, a new Gemstone progression track, and quality-of-life enhancements like "Mass Collect" for streamlined harvesting.
